slot_scores.name: truck_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about route-specific capacity limits, not about the number of containers a truck can carry. It never explicitly asked about truck capacity or the maximum containers per truck.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no relevant truck capacity limit / the hidden up-to-2-containers-per-truck constraint does not affect the model.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about or confirmed the truck capacity limit, but its READY_TO_MODEL summary states there are no other hidden constraints and omits any truck capacity restriction.

stopping_behavior.rationale: All P0/P1 hidden slots appear resolved or not material; the only missed hidden slot is P2 truck capacity, which does not affect the stated cost objective. Stopping was therefore appropriate despite the omitted P2 detail.

summary: The agent asked several useful clarification questions about supply/demand balance, integrality, cost structure, and route capacities, then stopped appropriately. However, it missed the hidden truck capacity limit (P2) and silently omitted it in the READY_TO_MODEL summary.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
